about.description: Who we are, how we work, and what we do well.
about.intro: StingSystem is a developer-led software studio: the person who analyses your requirements is the same one who designs, builds, deploys and supports the system after handover — no layers between you and whoever writes the code.
about.whatWeBuildBody: Systems, websites and applications built from analysis through deployment, in Arabic and English.
about.howWeWorkBody: Written phases with defined deliverables for each, and a review with you on a staging environment before launch.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: The fastest way to reach us, and the clearest way to start your project.
contact.preferWhatsapp: WhatsApp usually gets the fastest reply.
contact.sentBody: We will reply as soon as possible.
contact.startProjectBody: Use the project request form to send us sharper details.
contact.formHelp: For a general question or quick enquiry. We need your message and an email or phone number to reply; for a specific project, use the request form.

errors.contact: Add an email address or a phone number so we can reply.
errors.network: The message could not be sent. Your text is still on this page; check your connection and try again.

requestForm.pageDescription: Describe what you need in three short steps, and we will come back with an initial outline. A description and one way to reach you are enough; everything else is optional.
requestForm.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. We need a system to register school students and track fees…
requestForm.preferWhatsapp: Prefer to talk directly? Message us on WhatsApp
requestForm.successBody: We will review it and come back to you soon. Keep your reference number for follow-up.
requestForm.replyPromise: A reply within one business day
requestForm.scopeHelp: Pick what you need now — scope can grow later without a rebuild.
requestForm.budgetHelp: A rough estimate only — non-binding, it just helps us suggest a realistic scope.
requestForm.step2Help: These help us estimate scope. You can skip them entirely.
requestForm.step3Help: At least an email address or a phone number. Name and company are optional.
requestForm.descriptionHint: A sentence or two: the problem you want solved, or what you picture the system doing.
requestForm.nextStepEmail: We will review your request and reply to your email.
requestForm.nextStepPhone: We will review your request and contact you on the phone number you sent.

errors.description: Write a short description of what you need (at least ten characters).
errors.contact: Add an email address or a phone number so we can reply.
errors.network: The request could not be sent. Your answers are still on this page; check your connection and try again.
